requirements.description: User prefers energy class D or better, so the energy class must be D or any higher class (A1-A4, B, C, D). Size, capacity, Turin location and green-space proximity are not energy requirements and are not filtered here.
The user wants the property located near green spaces. Per the 'near' rule, the threshold is the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.

The user explicitly requires at least 600 sqm of gross floor area, so the explicit surface value is used as a >= threshold. The 45-children capacity is not converted into an area filter, since no verified gross-area threshold per child was supplied. The energy class (D or better) and proximity to green spaces have no matching reference column and are not extracted; the city of Turin is a geographic constraint handled by the Location Agent, so comune_code is left unset.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Attività scolastiche' AND surface_area >= 600 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') AND green >= 74 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters school-type properties (property_type = 'Attività scolastiche') with surface_area >= 600 m², energy_class in A1–D, green score >= 74, and within 3.0 km of the given coordinates. Results are ordered by haversine distance from that point, nearest first. The energy-class list is the extracted requirement; the nursery capacity and Turin place name were not turned into predicates because they have no matching column.
